name: Roll a Fisherman
creator: FISH X SPEEDI
redeem: Launch Roll a Fisherman on Roblox and finish the short tutorial.
Tap the Shop button on the left side of the screen (the plus icon next to your cash opens the same menu).
Scroll to the bottom of the Shop to find the Enter a code box.
Type or paste the code and press the green Redeem button.
notes:
Roll a Fisherman is an idle fishing tycoon from the FISH X SPEEDI group, released on Roblox in August 2026. You roll for fishermen of different rarities, place them on your dock, and they reel in fish that you set on stands to earn cash. That cash goes into upgrades and more rolls, and your fish keep earning while you are offline.

The game uses two currencies, cash and gold, plus spins for extra rolls, and its codes hand out a mix of all three. Free spins are the most useful early on because they give more chances at better fishermen. New codes have arrived with each numbered update and new feature, and the developers list them on the game's Roblox page and in their Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Roll a Fisherman codes?
faq.a: Finish the short tutorial first. The code box in the Shop only works after it.

faq.q: Is the Roll a Fisherman code SEAL or SEALS?
faq.a: The game's Roblox description lists it as SEAL, worth 3 spins. The game's title shows [SEALS] and some sites list the code as SEALS, so if SEAL doesn't work, try SEALS.

faq.q: What are cash, gold and spins in Roll a Fisherman?
faq.a: Cash comes from the fish your fishermen catch, and you spend it on upgrades and more rolls. Gold is the game's second currency. Spins are extra rolls for fishermen, which makes them the most useful code reward early on, since they give you more chances at better fishermen.

faq.q: Where does the Roll a Fisherman developer post new codes?
faq.a: FISH X SPEEDI lists codes on the game's Roblox page and in their Discord. New codes have tended to arrive with each numbered update, like UPDATE1 and UPDATE2.

tips: Place each new fisherman on the dock right after you roll it. A fisherman that is not on the dock does not catch anything for you.
Fish only earn cash once they sit on a stand. Keep moving the fish you catch onto your stands so your income never stalls.
Split your cash between upgrades and new rolls. Upgrades help what you already own, while rolls are your chance at a rarer fisherman.
Your fish earn even while you are offline, so set up your best fishermen and fill your stands before you leave the game.
useRewards: Roll a Fisherman codes come in three kinds. RELEASE gives 5,000 cash, which is a good start on your first upgrades. GOLD and UPGRADES give 800 gold together, so hold it until you see what gold buys in the Shop. The four spin codes add up to 10 spins, so redeem them back to back and place any good fisherman you pull on the dock straight away.
